claims.scope: Every odd finite cutoff, complete complex-vector divisor inverse and trace identity.
RH equivalent to subpower full-inverse growth; RH converse uses the named classical Mertens implication.
Every ternary shell, all couplings retained; uniform fresh/high-relative-forcing output bounds.
Q-AC26 implies RH; sequential version equivalent to Q-AC26. Its premise is not established.
Uniform arithmetic shell compactness for every eta>0 and every cutoff 3^r.
An explicit nonnative nonnegative multiplicative kernel defeats generic compactness; not a zeta counterexample.
No fixed positive coercivity gap, using existence of a critical-line zero.
